notes.title: Changed the difficulty balance
notes.content:
1. Changed the difficulty balance.
2. Special enemy "fastjumper-Troll" - Has less health, He began to attack more often.
3. Increased the timer for the appearance of a small horde during a large horde.
4. The number of special enemies appearing is now limited. At the same time, there can be - 1 Fire and 2 Trolls.
5. Increased the size of the signal rocket released by the squad in the forest.
6. Gameplay has become easier :)

notes.title: ITERRIA ZONE V1.3 09.04.2021
notes.content:
1. Episode 1 - The tank with the biomaterial that you must find is highlighted on the easy and medium difficulty levels.
2. Added a new special enemy "Fast-jumper"
3. Improved textures and terrain in the Animation for Episode 1
4. Key "1" no longer restarts the level.
